name: menubar-time
title: Menu Bar Time
description: Keep your favorite time zones in the menu bar with country flags and custom labels.
author: bogdan

commands.name: world-clocks
commands.title: World Clocks
commands.description: Show your selected time zones in the menu bar. Click a clock to copy its time.

commands.name: manage-time-zones
commands.title: Manage Time Zones
commands.description: Add, reorder, edit, or hide menu bar clocks and customize their flags and labels.

preferences.name: timeFormat
preferences.title: Time Format
preferences.description: Display time using a 24-hour or 12-hour clock.

preferences.name: showFlags
preferences.title: Menu Bar Appearance
preferences.description: Show each clock's flag or custom emoji beside its time in the menu bar.
preferences.label: Show flags and emoji

preferences.name: showLabels
preferences.description: Show city names or your custom labels in the menu bar.
preferences.label: Show clock labels

preferences.name: separator
preferences.title: Clock Separator
preferences.description: Separate clocks with a divider, a dot, or extra space.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:dist
